options swap_delay=12 iteration=3000 ignore_burst_energy=true;

fischl char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
fischl add weapon="slingshot" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
fischl add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
fischl add stats er=0.3;

kuki char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
kuki add weapon="ironsting" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
kuki add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
kuki add stats er=0.3;

zhongli char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
zhongli add weapon="blacktassel" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
zhongli add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
zhongli add stats er=0.3;

xingqiu char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
xingqiu add weapon="harbingerofdawn" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
xingqiu add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
xingqiu add stats er=0.3;

target lvl=100 resist=0.1 radius=2 pos=0,2.4 hp=999999999;

active fischl;
for let i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1 {
  fischl skill;
  kuki skill;
  zhongli skill;
  wait(700);
  fischl burst;
  wait(800);
}
